d:
The Grizzlies defeated the Clippers, 115-97 tonight in Memphis. Jaylen Wells contributed a team-high 19 points to go with 6 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Ty Jerome of the Grizzlies adding an additional 17 points (7-16 FG, 1-8 3P) in the game. Brandon Ingram finished with a team-high 18 points along with 5 rebounds for the Clippers in the losing effort. The Grizzlies improve their record to 14-5 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 4-13 for the season.
